title: Jennifer Lopez Returns to Las Vegas With Sold-Out ‘Up All Night’ Residency: Find Last-Minute Tickets Online
summary: Celebrate New Years with JLO in Las Vegas with shoes on Dec. 30 and 31.
contentText:

Start off the new year with Jennifer Lopez . Jenny-from-the-Block is hitting the strip for New Years Eve (and later in 2026) for her new Las Vegas residency show, Up All Night: Live in Vegas. Hitting the stage at the Colosseum at Caesars Palace, celebrate the legacy of JLO and all of her hits like “On the Floor,” “Let’s Get Loud,” “Love Don’t Cost a Thing,” and “If You Had My Love.”

This will mark Lopez’s second Las Vegas residency, following her 120-show Jennifer Lopez: All I Have run at the Zappos Theater at Planet Hollywood from 2016-2018 that grossed more than $100 million. The first run of shows kicks off today, Dec. 30 and 31, as well as January 2 and 3, with a return in early 2026 on March 6, 7, 13, 14, 20, 27 and 28.

Tickets are selling out quick, but there are plenty of ways to secure last-minute tickets through resell sites like StubHub and SeatGeek . Keep reading for a roundup all the best sites to get concert tickets to Jennifer Lopez’s Up All Night concert below.

Where to Get Tickets to Jennifer Lopez “Up All Night” Tour

Now that the tour is underway, resale tickets are going faster than usual. Thousands of fans are currently looking to score passes to a show, and if you’re one of them, tickets are available on sites such as Seat Geek , StubHub , Vivid Seats and TicketNetwork .

StubHub

Get Tickets Here

StubHub has Jennifer Lopez tickets available . Stubhub’s Fan Protect Guarantee ensures valid tickets or your money back. And if your event is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% in credit or be given the option of a full refund.

Vivid Seat

Get Tickets here

You can find Jennifer Lopez tickets online at Vivid Seats for as low as $92. The ticket site lets you search by price, location and “Super Sellers,” which denotes reputable sellers with the best deals on tickets.

Vivid Seats is great for group tickets: the site has a rewards program that gives you your eleventh ticket free (in the form of a credit) after you buy 10 tickets online. And as a bonus, you can use our exclusive promo code BB30 to take $30 off your purchase at VividSeats.com .

Seat Geek

Get Tickets here

One of the lowest prices we’re seeing for Jennifer Lopez tickets is at SeatGeek , which has stubs from $110 and up. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

Gametime

Get Tickets ONline

For more affordable tickets, Gametime is offering ticket options for as low as $109. Purchasers will receive the Gametime Guarantee, which includes event cancellation protection, a low-price guarantee and one-time ticket delivery. Bonus offer: Get $20 off orders of $150+ when you use the code SAVE20 at checkout.

TicketNetwork

Get Tickets online

TicketNetwork has tickets to Jennifer Lopez’s concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). For a limited time, you can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off $500 or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.
